user.title: Tenant and landlord
user.description: Tell us who the tenant and the landlord are and how payment is made. The details are used in the email to the tenant and on the tenant page. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data_description.leietaker_navn: Shown on the tenant page. The first name is used in the greeting of the email.
data_description.leietaker_epost: The monthly settlement is sent here. Try your own address first and change it later under Configure.
data_description.adresse: Shown on the page. The street address (the part before the first comma) is used in the email subject.
data_description.innflyttet: The date the tenancy started. Shown on the tenant page.
data_description.utleier_navn: The name shown as the sender of the email and as the landlord on the page.
data_description.utleier_epost: The sender address of the email, and where the test email goes. A copy of each settlement can also be sent here.
data_description.kontonummer: Shown on the page and in the email as the account the tenant pays to.
data_description.forfallsdag: The day of the month after the period when the amount is due (1–28). From that day the settlement is automatically marked as paid.

kilder.title: Data sources
kilder.description:
The integration does not calculate the house's electricity price itself. It reads ready-made figures from sensors you already have, and you choose which ones here.

**Must be correct for settlements to be created:** the electricity accounts (the house's figures), the meter (the apartment's usage) and the notification service. The utility_meter is used as a check.

**Display and estimate only:** power and forecast. The form requires a sensor for both, but they do not affect the settlement itself.

The defaults match the original setup.

data.maaler_start_stand: Meter reading at the start of this month (kWh)

data_description.ent_regnskap: The sensor with the house's electricity figures per month. It needs the attribute “maneder” (a list of closed months, each with mnd, kwh, kraft, nettleie, norgespris, sum and snitt, and preferably leilighet_kwh) and “denne_maneden” (the same fields for the current month). The house's average price is taken only from here.
data_description.ent_utility: The apartment's usage so far this month in kWh, from a meter that resets every month (a utility_meter with a monthly cycle). Used as a check against the meter readings (the attribute “last_period” is last month's final value) and for the “so far” figures.
data_description.ent_import: The apartment's meter reading in kWh, as the meter counts up by itself (it is never reset). This is the main source of usage: usage in a month is the meter reading at the month change minus the reading at the previous month change. The integration stores the reading at every month change.
data_description.ent_effekt: The apartment's instantaneous power in W. Used for display only (as the attribute effekt_w) and does not affect the settlement.
data_description.ent_prognose: The sensor that says how much usage is expected to change compared with last month, in percent. It needs the attribute “endring_prosent”. Used only for the monthly estimate (last month's kWh × (1 + percent/100)). Without it no estimate is shown.
data_description.varsel_tjeneste: Where notifications to you as landlord are sent, for example when a settlement awaits approval or an email fails. Write the service as notify.name. You can find the names under Developer tools → Actions by searching for “notify”. The service must exist before you can continue.
data_description.maaler_start_stand: Used only the first time, if Home Assistant has no history for the meter reading from the start of this month. A new meter that started at 0 should be left at 0. Later month changes are read from the meter automatically.
data_description.lader_aktiv: Turn on if the tenant also uses an EV charger that does not go through the apartment meter. Its consumption is then priced at the same average price as the rest and shown as a separate line on the invoice basis. Off by default.
data_description.ent_lader: The charger's energy counter in kWh that never resets, for example «Lifetime energy» from Easee. Consumption for a month is the counter at the month change minus the counter at the previous month change. Only used when the charger is turned on.

epost.title: Email (SMTP)
epost.description: The settlement is sent from Home Assistant through the email account you provide. For Gmail: server smtp.gmail.com, port 587, your Gmail username and an **app password** (not your regular password). You create an app password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords and it requires 2-step verification. The password is stored unencrypted in Home Assistant's configuration, so create a dedicated one.

data.cc_utleier: Send a copy to the landlord
data.send_test: Send a test email to the landlord now
data.kopi_til_utleier: Send a copy with PDFs and a backup to the landlord after each settlement

data_description.smtp_host: The address of the mail server. For Gmail: smtp.gmail.com.
data_description.smtp_port: Port for the encrypted connection (STARTTLS). For Gmail: 587.
data_description.smtp_bruker: The username of the email account, usually the full address. Suggested from the landlord's email.
data_description.smtp_passord: The 16-character app password from Google, not your regular Google password. Spaces in the password do not matter.
data_description.cc_utleier: Sends a copy of each settlement to the landlord's address, so you see exactly what the tenant receives.
data_description.send_test: Sends a test email to the landlord's address when you continue, to show that the login works. Nothing is sent to the tenant now.
data_description.kopi_til_utleier: After the settlement has been sent to the tenant, the landlord gets an email with the subject “Fakturagrunnlag strøm leilighet”. Attached are the invoice basis and the full accounts as PDF, and a backup of all data (JSON). It gives a copy outside Home Assistant.

side.title: Tenant page
side.description:
The tenant gets a permanent link to an ordinary web page showing the outstanding amount, usage so far this month and history. The page needs no login, and the link has a secret random part so it cannot be guessed. It is the same link as in the email. If Nabu Casa is on, that address is used, otherwise the external URL.

Link: {lenke}

data_description.publiser_side: If you turn this off no page is created and the link stops working. Emails are then sent without a link.

grenser.title: Sanity checks and run time
grenser.description: The settlement is created automatically once a month and checked before it is sent. If it breaks one of the rules below no email is sent: you get a notification and must approve the settlement yourself (or fix the data first).

data.endring_maks_prosent: Max change in kWh versus the previous period (±%)
data.kjoredag: First run day of the month

data_description.snitt_min: A house average price lower than this is treated as an error (NOK/kWh).
data_description.snitt_maks: A house average price higher than this is treated as an error (NOK/kWh).
data_description.endring_maks_prosent: How much the apartment's kWh may differ from the previous period, up or down, before you must approve the settlement yourself. 60 means ±60 %.
data_description.kjoredag: The day of the month (1–28) when the integration starts creating the settlement for the previous month.
data_description.kjoretid: The time of day on the run day when it starts trying. Also used as the time of the warning if data is missing.
data_description.siste_sjekkdag: The last day it keeps trying if the data is not ready. After that you must run “Generate settlement” yourself. Cannot be before the run day.

importer.title: Existing history
importer.description:
Import the periods that have already been invoiced so history and outstanding amounts are correct from the start:

{historikk}

data_description.importer_historikk: Recommended. Without the import the previous month does not exist, and the integration then creates and sends a settlement for it to the tenant as soon as it is set up, if that is between the run day and the last check day.

reconfigure.title: New tenant
reconfigure.description: Enter the details of the new tenant. The previous tenant's history has been archived and the link replaced.

data_description.adresse: Shown on the page. The street address (the part before the first comma) is used in the email subject.
data_description.innflyttet: The date the tenancy started. Shown on the tenant page.

datagrunnlag.description: The month change is approaching, and this must be fixed before the settlement can be created safely: {problemer}

generer_oppgjor.name: Generate settlement
generer_oppgjor.description: Creates the monthly settlement for a period.

periode.name: Period
periode.description: The month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the previous month.

tving.name: Override sanity checks
tving.description: Create the settlement even if the sanity checks fail.

send_epost.name: Send email
send_epost.description: Email the settlement to the tenant.

godkjenn_oppgjor.name: Approve settlement
godkjenn_oppgjor.description: Sends a settlement that is awaiting approval.

send_epost_pa_nytt.name: Send email again
send_epost_pa_nytt.description: Sends the settlement to the tenant again.

sett_status.name: Set payment status
sett_status.description: Sets the status of a period. Use unntak_ikke_betalt to stop an overdue period from being marked paid automatically.

slett_periode.name: Delete period
slett_periode.description: Deletes a period from the history. This cannot be undone.

bekreft.name: Confirm
bekreft.description: Must be true for the period to be deleted.

ny_leietaker.name: New tenant
ny_leietaker.description: Archives and clears the history, replaces the tenant link and opens reconfiguration for the new tenant's details.

send_lenke.name: Send link to tenant
send_lenke.description: Sends a short email to the tenant with the link to the tenant page. Use it the first time the tenant should get the link, or if it has been lost.

merk_betalt.name: Mark as paid
merk_betalt.description: Marks outstanding settlements as paid. Without a period all outstanding ones are marked (including those with “exception”). Settlements awaiting approval are left alone.

periode.name: Period
periode.description: The month as YYYY-MM. Leave empty to mark everything outstanding as paid.

sett_malerstand.name: Set meter reading
sett_malerstand.description: Enters or corrects the meter reading at a month change. Use it if a reading is missing, for example because Home Assistant was down at midnight.

dato.name: Date
dato.description: The first day of the month, for example 2026-12-01 or 2026-12. The reading applies at midnight into that month.

stand.name: Meter reading (kWh)
stand.description: What the meter showed at the month change.

maaler.name: Meter
maaler.description: Which counter the reading applies to: «leilighet» (apartment, default) or «lader» (charger). «lader» requires the charger to be turned on in the setup.

send_regnskap.name: Send accounts to me
send_regnskap.description: Sends an email to you as landlord with the invoice basis for a period, the full accounts (PDF) and a JSON backup as attachments. Without a period the latest settlement is used.

periode.name: Period
periode.description: The month as YYYY-MM. Leave empty for the latest settlement.

send_faktura.name: Send invoice to tenant
send_faktura.description: Sends the tenant an email with the link to the tenant page and the invoice for a period attached as a PDF. Without a period the latest settlement is used. Use it to resend an invoice with a fresh link, for example after the tenant's email address was changed.

periode.name: Period
periode.description: The month as YYYY-MM. Leave empty for the latest settlement.
